title: 第21章 领取月例挑选功法第22章 闭门苦修功法大成
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 天刚破晓，晨雾缭绕青岚宗前山。
朝阳微光穿透云层，洒落在外门连绵屋舍之间。
山间空气清新，灵气浓郁醇厚，远非后山杂役院可比。
外门居住区已然渐渐热闹起来。
一众外门弟子早早起身，或去往演武堂练拳演武，或赶往藏经阁借阅玄功，或是前往库房等候领取月例资源。
人人步履从容，气息沉稳，带着宗门弟子独有的气度。
林宸走出自家小院，顺着青石山道，缓步朝外门库房行去。
沿途不时有新晋外门弟子擦肩而过，大多还会驻足寒暄，彼此结交人脉。
唯有林宸独来独往，神色淡漠，不与人搭话，不刻意合群。
旁人见他气质清冷、性子孤冷，也不敢随意上前攀谈。
一路直行，不多时便抵达外门库房所在之地。
库房是一座古朴厚重的木石结构建筑，院门敞开，院内堆放着下品灵石、丹药、符箓等各类修行物资。
几名库房执事端坐案后，神情肃穆，有条不紊处理弟子领例事宜。
此刻已有不少外门弟子排队等候，皆是来领取每月固定的下品灵石与丹药。
队伍秩序井然，无人喧哗，人人安静排队。
林宸默默走到队伍末尾，静静伫立等候。
目光淡然扫视库房四周，将环境布局尽数记在心底。
青岚宗外门的资源分配规矩，他前世早已了然于心。
外门弟子每月五枚下品灵石、三枚基础淬体丹，数量固定，不多不少。
对于普通低阶修士而言，这份月例勉强够日常修行消耗。
但想要快速突破境界、淬炼肉身，仅凭这点资源远远不够，还需另寻机缘。
队伍缓缓向前挪动，不时有弟子上前报出名号与居所编号。
执事核对名册过后，便随手分发下品灵石与丹药。
领到资源的弟子，大多面露欣喜，小心翼翼收好，转身离去。
片刻之后，轮到林宸上前。
“弟子林宸，新晋外门。”
他语气平静，不卑不亢。
执事低头翻看名册，找到名字后，抬眼打量了林宸一眼。
昨日考核擂台之上，林宸从容制胜的表现，不少执事都记在心里。
知晓这名新晋弟子心性沉稳，实力不俗。
执事没有多言，取出五枚莹白下品灵石、三枚圆润的青灰色淬体丹，推到林宸面前。
“收好，每月初一准时来领，过时不候。”
林宸伸手接过灵石丹药，指尖触感微凉。
下品灵石内蕴含精纯灵气，丹药药香清淡，都是低阶修士最常用的修行之物。
他微微颔首道谢，转身退出队伍。
走到僻静无人处，低头打量手中资源。
content_en:
Dawn has just broken, and morning mist surrounds the front mountain of Qinglan Sect.
The glimmer of the morning sun penetrates the clouds and falls between the consecutive houses outside the gate.
The air in the mountains is fresh and the spiritual energy is rich and mellow, which is far beyond the comparison with the back-mountain handyman courtyard.
The outer gate residential area has gradually become lively.
A group of outer disciples got up early and either went to the martial arts hall to practice boxing or martial arts, or rushed to the Tibetan Sutra Pavilion to borrow Xuan Kung, or went to the warehouse to wait to receive monthly resources.
Everyone walks calmly, has a calm aura, and carries the unique bearing of a sect disciple.
Lin Chen walked out of his small courtyard, followed the bluestone mountain road, and walked slowly towards the outer warehouse.
Along the way, new outer disciples would pass by each other from time to time, and most of them would stop to chat and make connections with each other.
Lin Chen was the only one who walked around alone, with an indifferent expression, did not talk to others, and did not deliberately join in the group.
Seeing his cold temperament and lonely temperament, others did not dare to come up and talk to him casually.
Go straight all the way and soon you will arrive at the outer warehouse.
The warehouse is a simple and heavy wooden and stone structure building, with the courtyard door open, and various cultivation materials such as low-grade spiritual stones, elixirs, and talismans are piled in the courtyard.
After several warehouse deacons sat at the table, they looked solemn and dealt with the disciples' matters in an orderly manner.
At this moment, there are many outer disciples waiting in line, all coming to receive the fixed monthly low-grade spiritual stones and elixirs.
The queue was in order, no one was making any noise, and everyone was lining up quietly.
Lin Chen silently walked to the end of the line and stood waiting quietly.
He glanced around the warehouse indifferently, memorizing the layout of the environment in his mind.
He had already understood the resource allocation rules of the Qinglan Sect's outer sect in his previous life.
Outer disciples receive five low-grade spiritual stones and three basic body-tempering pills every month. The quantity is fixed, no more, no less.
For ordinary low-level monks, this monthly routine is barely enough for daily practice.
But if you want to quickly break through the realm and temper your body, this resource alone is far from enough, and you need to find another opportunity.
The team moved forward slowly, and from time to time, disciples came forward to report their names and residence numbers.
After the deacon checked the roster, he casually distributed low-grade spiritual stones and elixirs.
Most of the disciples who received the resources showed joy on their faces, carefully put them away, and turned around to leave.
After a while, it was Lin Chen's turn to step forward.
"Disciple Lin Chen, newly promoted to the outer sect."
His tone was calm, neither humble nor arrogant.
The deacon lowered his head and looked through the roster. After finding his name, he raised his eyes and looked at Lin Chen.
Lin Chen's calm and winning performance in the assessment arena yesterday was remembered by many deacons.
I know that this new disciple has a calm mind and good strength.
Without saying anything, the deacon took out five crystal white low-grade spirit stones and three round blue-grey body tempering pills and pushed them in front of Lin Chen.
"Put it away and come to collect it on time on the first day of every month. Don't wait if it's late."
Lin Chen stretched out his hand to take the spirit stone pill, and his fingertips felt slightly cool.
Low-grade spiritual stones contain pure spiritual energy, and elixirs have a light fragrance. They are the most commonly used cultivation tools for low-level monks.
He nodded slightly and thanked her, then turned around and exited the team.
Walking to a quiet and uninhabited place, he lowered his head and looked at the resources in his hands.
